findings.detail: The dl_rate_fill flag is driven by source-native undrawn commitment rows whose Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns are dashes, not by missing extraction of stated coupons.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate fill-rate warning: the bundle reports 133 missing-rate violations out of 359 units, but raw SOI rows show many First Lien - Undrawn positions where the filer itself prints dashes in the Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns while carrying unfunded par/cost/fair-value fields. Ordinary funded rows in the same schedule have populated Reference/Spread/Interest Rate cells, so the missing-rate pattern is localized to rule scope over source-native undrawn rows rather than a data extraction defect.
